_source: "Self-occupied; construction completed six years after the end of the tax year of borrowing; interest ₹2,50,000." "HP-CAP-SELFOCC-001(i) not satisfied → the ₹30,000 limb applies; deduction = min(2,50,000 , 30,000) = 30,000"; "Expected: ₹30,000." So the head is −₹30,000, set off whole. Old regime (the DR 08 matrix column). INFERENCE, not DR 08's: no pre-construction interest; the house completed in the year run, six years after the end of the tax year of borrowing (completedYearsAfterBorrowingYear 6); the lender's certificate held. INFERENCE, not DR 08's (D-217 C5): the other-sources deposit interest of ₹3,00,000 that absorbs the loss — DR 08 states no income under another head, and any amount of ₹2,00,000 or more gives the same set-off.
